sloka: ते ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं रावणं रिपुरावणम्।कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं चैव महाकायाः प्रतस्थिरे ।। ६.६९.१७ ।।
transliteration: te 'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ rāvaṇaṁ ripurāvaṇam।kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṁ caiva mahākāyāḥ pratasthire ।। 6.69.17 ।।

translations.english: Those heroes greeting gigantic Ravana, went around him clockwise (as per tradition) and departed.
